title: benchdiff config
description: Options file for benchdiff (--config). Keys are the kebab-case names of the CLI flags and Action inputs; command-line flags and Action inputs override the file.

threshold.description: Percent change below which a row is unchanged.

thresholds.description: Per-metric thresholds in percent; the 'default' entry replaces 'threshold' (set only one of the two).

min-abs.description: Ignore changes smaller than this absolute amount.

sort.description: Row order; 'rank' applies to matrix output only.

max-rows.description: Maximum rows shown in the report.

fail-on-regression.description: Exit non-zero when a regression exceeds this percent.

tag.description: Marker used to find and update an existing PR comment.

format.description: Input format of the head file.

base-format.description: Input format of the base file.

charts.description: Comma-separated chart kinds: delta, ranking, distribution, or 'none'.

svg-dir.description: Directory to write chart SVG files to.

svg-embed.description: Embed charts in the Markdown as data URIs.

publish-images.description: Publish chart SVGs and link them from the comment.

compare-by.description: Dimension to compare variants along; not 'measure'.

group-by.description: Dimensions that group the matrix rows.

dimensions.description: Rules 'dim=regex' that extract a dimension from benchmark names (array, or one rule per line).

dimensions-strict.description: Fail when a benchmark name matches no dimension rule.

reference.description: Variant label the others are compared against (1 to 40 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -).
